text: Or, their tumultuous persons. Hebr. tumult.
Heb. thogh their life were yet among the liuing. , Or, whose life is in his iniquitie. Heb. his iniquitie.
Isai. 13.7. iere. 6.24. , Heb. goe into water.
Heb. for a separation or vncleannesse. , Prou.11. 4. zeph.1. 18. ecclus. 5.8. , Or, because their iniquitie is their stumbling blocke.
Or, made it vnto them an vncleane thing.
Or, they shall inherit their holy places.
